_README: REAL-A6 viam-server ROBOT config for #37 (module-on-real-A6). Wraps the
etc/a6-hardware.example.json component in a full machine config (components +
modules). EXAMPLE-SAFE: set the two host-specific values marked <SET-ME> before use.
1) modules[0].executable_path -> the unpacked module entrypoint (after `viam module` build/unpack).
2) components[0].attributes.interface -> the real EtherCAT NIC (e.g. enp86s0).
See docs/a6-bringup-runbook.md + docs/deployment-capabilities.md (caps).
!!! Confirm the PDO map + counts_per_rev vs THIS drive's ESI/nameplate before energizing !!!
REAL-HARDWARE A6-EC servo config for the viam:ethercat:servo motor model --
the companion to etc/a6-servo.example.json (which is sim-only). This is the
artifact Phase 7 (real bring-up) starts from: plug in, set `interface`, run.
!!! CONFIRM BEFORE ENERGIZING !!!
Every PDO index/subindex/bit-length, the modes-of-operation code, and the
encoder/gear/current values below MUST be verified against THIS drive's ESI
file and the motor nameplate before applying power. The CiA402 object indices
(0x6040/0x6041/0x607A/0x6064/0x60FF) are standard and are what the controller
resolves per mode; the PDO *assignment* (which objects sit in 0x1600/0x1A00 and
whether the drive permits runtime remap via CoE) is drive-specific. A wrong map
or a wrong counts_per_rev will command the motor incorrectly. require_realtime
is true here -- the host needs CAP_SYS_NICE / RLIMIT_RTPRIO or start() throws.
Authoritative map verified against the A6 manual section 10 (object dictionary
+ PDO config). Object indices in DECIMAL (JSON has no hex):
0x6040=24640 controlword (16b)        0x6041=24641 statusword (16b)
0x607A=24698 target position (32b)    0x6064=24676 position actual (32b)
0x6081=24705 profile velocity (32b)   0x606C=24684 velocity actual (32b)
0x60FF=24831 target velocity (32b)    0x603F=24639 fault code (16b)
0x6060=24672 modes-of-operation (8b, SDO-set, PP=1/PV=3, NOT in the map)
0x6061=24673 mode display (8b)        0x6077=24695 torque actual (16b)
RxPDO 0x1600=5632 on SM2 assign 0x1C12=7186
TxPDO 0x1A00=6656 on SM3 assign 0x1C13=7187
PP RxPDO (3 entries/10B): controlword + target position + profile velocity
(0x6081 carries the GoTo/GoFor rpm -- the RT loop writes it every cycle).
PV RxPDO (2 entries/6B): controlword + target velocity (signed = direction).
TxPDO (6 entries/15B, both modes): fault code, statusword, mode display,
position actual, velocity actual, torque actual.
This file shows the PROFILE POSITION (PP) component. For a PROFILE VELOCITY (PV)
drive, see the `_pv_variant` block at the bottom: set control_mode=PV and swap
the RxPDO entry from target-position 0x607A to target-velocity 0x60FF (the
controller resolves 0x607A only in PP and 0x60FF only in PV, and throws if the
required object is not mapped).
components.name: servo

attributes._comment_model: #15 item 2: the A6 uses the viam:ethercat:a6-servo model -- an A6ServoDriver subclass carrying the vendor fault-reset (0x2031:01=1), the no-SYNC0 code (0x8700/Er74.1), and its 0x603F gloss in CODE, not config.
attributes._comment_bus: interface = the host NIC bound to the EtherCAT segment (CONFIRM: `ip link`). slave = 1-based ring position of the A6.
attributes._comment_mode: control_mode PP -> modes-of-operation 0x6060 = 1 (set via SDO from this field).
attributes._comment_motor: CONFIRM against the MOTOR nameplate (these are motor-, not drive-, specific): rated speed, rated current, peak current.
attributes._comment_kinematics: counts_per_rev = 2^17 = 131072 (A6 single-turn encoder resolution -- CONFIRM the encoder bits on the nameplate/ESI). gear_ratio = motor revs per output rev (CONFIRM the mechanical reduction; 1.0 = direct drive).
attributes._comment_rt: require_realtime=true: hard-fail if SCHED_FIFO is unavailable (a real drive must run RT). loop_rate_hz <= 1000. rt_priority 1..99. use_distributed_clocks=true is REQUIRED for the A6 (it supports ONLY DC sync; without SYNC0 it faults out of OP -- Er74.1, WKC->0). The SYNC0 cycle = 1e9/loop_rate_hz MUST be an integer multiple of 250us for the A6 -> loop_rate_hz in {1000,500,250,...}; 1000 Hz = 1 ms = 4x250us. sync_cycle_granularity_ns=250000 DECLARES that 250us granularity so a bad rate is rejected at CONFIG time with the valid alternatives, instead of the drive faulting cryptically at OP entry (Er74.0).
attributes._comment_tuning: Move-complete + watchdog tuning -- CONFIRM/tune on the bench. velocity_threshold is in device velocity units (counts/s).
attributes._comment_pdo: CONFIRM the entry maps + that the A6 permits CoE PDO remap on these indices (per its ESI). PP RxPDO (command): controlword + target position + profile velocity (the RT loop writes the rpm into 0x6081 each cycle). TxPDO (feedback): fault code + statusword + mode display + position actual + velocity actual + torque actual.

_pv_variant._comment: PROFILE VELOCITY drive: apply these two changes to the attributes above. control_mode=PV -> modes-of-operation 0x6060 = 3. The RxPDO swaps target position 0x607A (24698) for target velocity 0x60FF (24831); the TxPDO is unchanged (statusword + position actual). set_rpm drives a signed velocity; go_to is rejected in PV.
